scenario.name: r-cw-delegate-self-continuation
scenario.description: Fires continue_delegate that internally calls continue_work — proves hop-2 woke inside a delegate child session. The delegate dispatches, the child fires its own continue_work, and the hop-2 turn executes.

invocation.promptTemplate: k6 proof R-CW-DELEGATE-SELF nonce {{nonce}}: after arriving, call continue_work(reason="k6-self-continuation-{{nonce}}", delaySeconds=2). After the continue_work tool result reports scheduled, reply exactly CHILD-CW-SCHEDULED {{nonce}}. On hop-2 wake, reply exactly CHILD-HOP2-DONE {{nonce}}. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

expectedReceipts.name: child-spawned
expectedReceipts.description: Corroborative only: concrete delegate lifecycle/child-session signal (not arbitrary nonce event)

expectedReceipts.name: child-continue-work-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch non-harness CHILD-CW-SCHEDULED sentinel emitted after child continue_work tool result reports scheduled

expectedReceipts.name: child-hop-2-woke
expectedReceipts.description: Child's hop-2 turn executed and emitted CHILD-HOP2-DONE sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: parent-return
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return event observed post-dispatch on parent session

review.notes: Delegate self-continuation: detector must ignore [k6-proof-harness] prompt-echo events and count only post-dispatch evidence. PASS-candidate now requires delegate-accepted + child-continue-work-accepted + child-hop-2-woke + parent-return. child-spawned is corroborative only unless a concrete lifecycle signal is available.

liveRunSafety.notes: Delegate self-continuation row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true for repeatability. Serialize per session (sameSessionConcurrencySafe=false). Ignore [k6-proof-harness] prompt echo; only post-dispatch evidence counts. PASS requires explicit post-dispatch CHILD-CW-SCHEDULED, CHILD-HOP2-DONE, and parent-return evidence; otherwise fold as PARTIAL-candidate.
